integrity: The original Gaussian-diagonal coefficient formula is attributed to Song and Zhang (2026); the asserted exact all-finite-row mixture, sharp far-tail law and moment threshold are derived independently here. Priority is qualified by possible earlier equivalent Gaussian-ratio results.
scientific_limitations: One-column full-rank least squares, independently and uniformly sampled Hadamard rows with replacement, and a shared Gaussian diagonal. The result does not apply to balanced Gaussian pooling, sampling without replacement, or regularization. The full all-integer moment claim is analytic; finite numerical tests are supporting diagnostics only.
title: An exact rare-Cauchy tail in Gaussian-diagonal Hadamard sketch-and-solve
